scripts.pods: cd ios && rm -rf build && rm -f Podfile.lock && USE_FRAMEWORKS=static bundle exec pod install --repo-update && rm -f .xcode.env.local
scripts.pods:nuke: cd ios && rm -rf Pods && rm -rf build && rm -f Podfile.lock && USE_FRAMEWORKS=static bundle exec pod install --repo-update && rm -f ios/.xcode.env.local
scripts.nuke: rm -rf $TMPDIR/react-* && watchman watch-del-all && rm -rf ios/build && rm -rf node_modules/ && rm -rf ./ios/Pods && yarn
scripts.build:android: cd android && bundle exec fastlane android build_example
scripts.build:ios: cd ios && bundle exec fastlane build_example
scripts.release:android: cd android && bundle exec fastlane distribute --verbose
scripts.release:ios: cd ios && bundle exec fastlane distribute --verbose
scripts.notify:android: cd android && bundle exec fastlane notify_slack
scripts.notify:ios: cd ios && bundle exec fastlane notify_slack
scripts.e2e:build-android: bash -c 'DETOX_AVD_NAME=${DETOX_AVD_NAME:-$(emulator -list-avds | head -n 1)}; if [ -z "$DETOX_AVD_NAME" ]; then echo "No Android AVD found. Set DETOX_AVD_NAME to override."; exit 1; fi; DETOX_AVD_NAME="$DETOX_AVD_NAME" detox build --configuration android.emu.debug'
scripts.e2e:run-android: bash -c 'DETOX_AVD_NAME=${DETOX_AVD_NAME:-$(emulator -list-avds | head -n 1)}; if [ -z "$DETOX_AVD_NAME" ]; then echo "No Android AVD found. Set DETOX_AVD_NAME to override."; exit 1; fi; DETOX_AVD_NAME="$DETOX_AVD_NAME" detox test --configuration android.emu.debug'
